summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Audit Committee and Board dismissed WWC, P.C. as independent registered public accounting firm and appointed Privatco CPA Limited for fiscal 2026, both effective October 16, 2026. WWC's audit reports for fiscal 2024 and 2025 were unqualified, with no disagreements or reportable events under Form 20-F Item 16F(a)(1)(iv)/(v). WWC furnished its concurring Exhibit 16.1 letter to the SEC. Disclosures are incorporated by reference into the Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. This is an auditor change, not a special situation; watch for any restatement or control-deficiency signals.
